Marta (product): Quick thread: Vertex Bio wants a compact private-deploy roadmap covering customer-managed networking, deterministic upgrade windows, and an auditable rollback. They asked for concrete acceptance tests and a phased timeline.
Ibrahim (eng-runtime): My recommendation: Phase 1 = managed BGP peering + DNS handoff automation + canary API + rollback playbook. Phase 2 = IP continuity (VIP/floating IP orchestration) + installer flags for customer route tables + airgap polish. Phase1 ~ 2-3w, Phase2 ~ 5-8w.
Ellen (field): Vertex's NetOps insists on <60s service disruption and KMS-backed key rotation. They prefer an approach that avoids IP reassignments.
Sam (solutions): For Phase1 we can provide a "controlled cutover" runbook: mirror traffic, warm caches, ramp weight, then finalize DNS TTL change. That should meet the <60s disruption if done with short TTLs and ramping. We'll include verification commands.
Ibrahim (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: need control-plane steps: mirror -> cache-warm -> health-checks -> traffic-ramp -> finalize. Add feature flags `vip_swap_mode` and `preserve_ips`. Full strict-preserve requires Phase2 installer/CNI changes.
Marta (product): Proposed deliverables for Phase1 (Q3): BGP peering support, DNS handoff automation, canary/promote API, controlled-cutover runbook, acceptance test harness, KMS audit logs. Phase2 (Q4) to address IP-preserve and offline installer. Agree to escalate SLA language to legal for sign-off.
Ellen (field): Vertex will accept Phase1 if we include: (1) NetOps handoff doc, (2) an end-to-end staging play they can run, (3) cost estimate for reserved capacity during the ramp. I'll collect the SLA thresholds and share.
Sam (solutions): I'll stub the runbook and harness. Example verify steps: ```
# health check for canary
curl -H "Host: vertex-canary" https://private.vertex/healthz
# promote canary
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/promote -d '{"tenant":"vertex-canary"}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"tenant":"vertex-canary"}'
```
handshake-bot: Draft runbook created: /docs/private-deploys/vertex-handshake.md. Owner: Sam. Reviewers: Ibrahim, Ellen.
Ibrahim (eng-runtime): Dependency: installer change to accept customer route tables and static VIPs. I'll open RFC and prototype `vip_swap_mode: controlled` this sprint. If BGP isn't avail for a customer, fallback to managed peering + controlled-cutover.
Marta (product): Action items: Sam deliver runbook + harness by Tue, Ibrahim publish RFC and prototype by Thu, Ellen confirm Vertex SLA numbers and cost constraints by Wed. We'll present Phase1 plan at Friday steering. If anything slips, escalate to PM leadership. :thumbsup:
